title: Boris Vian, trumpeter and songwriter
summary: Vian played a tiny trumpet, started playing jazz at the Tabou in 1945 before Luter, was Bix-like but not a good player, a Saint-Germain figure, and also an engineer, songwriter and playwright.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: Uh, we were mentioning Boris Vian. Is that his name?
Trompette. En fait, he l'appelait trompinette, because it was a very, very small trumpet.
Yes. Very small corner, and he l'appelait trompinette.
And what style did he play?

Oh, yes. In 1945, he played at Taboo. He was the first musician French to play at the Jazz in New Orleans. In fact, I think he was the first, before Luther. Because he played during the war, at that time I was too young to know him. But I know that he started in 1945, at Taboo, to play jazz with others, before Luther started, because Luther started commercially in 1947 and 1948.
Did he get his inspiration from anyone? That's what I'm getting at. Did you say that? Did he have an inspiration? Armstrong, Oliver, Tommy Ladnere? Did he play like anyone or was he original?
He was like Bix. I see. So he was not the same style as Luther then?
Ah, no style, yes. Je n'ai pas compris. Non, pas exactement.
Not exactly. But he was well known.
Not very well. C'était une figure très pittoresque de Saint-Germain-des-Prés. But he was not a very good trumpet player.
And did you tell the other things he did other than play trumpet?

He was an engineer. He had studied math. He played trumpet. He wrote songs. He wrote very beautiful songs. They are now very popular. They are now completely popular. They are recorded by many singers. He had been singing by dear and he has never paid money with his books. He also wrote a theater piece. Very beautiful. And now we find him, a few years after his death, and there is a great fashion of Boris Vian, at Paris. We play his books, we have edited all his books, and his songs. He recorded some songs, as a singer. He wasn't a very good singer, but it was still a good singer.
